items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the criminal procedure law, in relation to designating certain code enforcement officers employed by the town of Southampton as peace officers
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S7371

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the criminal procedure law, in relation to designating
certain code enforcement officers employed by the town of Southampton
as peace officers

 PURPOSE :
Designates certain code enforcement officers employed by the town of
Southampton as peace officers.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section 1 adds a new subdivision 83 to include certain officers of the
town of Southampton as peace officers.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The State of New York grants peace officers specific powers under its
Criminal Procedure Law (CPL), including the ability to make
warrantless searches and arrests, use requisite force, and issue
summonses under Section 2.20 of that law.

Uniformed court officers, bay constables, and fire marshals employed
by the Town of Southampton are registered as peace officers under CPL
Section 2.10.

Due to the nature and frequency of its staff's respective duties, the
Town of Southampton Code Enforcement Department is in need of
personnel with specialized training to augment efforts to address
property maintenance issues, overcrowding, noise, rental law permits,
taxi licensing and inspections, truck and bus exclusions of the Town
Code, all terrain vehicles, peddling, and others affecting the quality
of life of town residents.

The designation of code enforcement employees as peace officers will
provide additional specialized New York State certified training
available only to peace officers recognized on the New York State
Peace Officer Registry.

Such training will enhance the operation of the Code Enforcement
Department and the effectiveness of its members in discharging their
official duties.

The Town Board of the Town of Southampton supports the enactment of
this legislation.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New Bill, 2010.

 FISCAL IMPACT ON THE STATE :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Designates the code enforcement officers employed by the town of Southampton as peace officers, including the chief town investigator, town investigator, ordinance enforcement officer, ordinance inspector and noise control officer.
